title: WAY TOO COSTLY
text: WAY TOO COSTLY. I buy these every year for my Halloween party.  They are awesome and I love the large 2oz size.  That said, I use 75-100 every year and it costs a fortune.  Yes, they’re reusable and no I’m not following guests around to reclaim used ones.  Even if I did, the caps are the first to go and the syringe is useless without.  Despite the cost, they are a huge hit at my parties and I have to have them!

product_metadata.title: BESTONZON 25 Pack Jello Shot Set, 2 OZ Food Grade Party Syringe with 30 Caps, Durable Reusable Plastic Jello Shot Syringes for Bachelorette Parties
